name: DR Congo

flag.description: A sky-blue field with a red diagonal band, edged in yellow, running from the lower hoist to the upper fly, and a yellow five-pointed star in the upper hoist corner.
flag.symbolism: Blue stands for peace, red for the blood of the country's martyrs, yellow for its wealth, and the star for a radiant future.

hook: DR Congo has a sky-blue field with a yellow star in the corner; its neighbour Congo-Brazzaville has no blue and no star.
trivia: From 1971 to 1997 the country was called Zaire and flew a green flag showing a hand holding a flaming torch.
It is the second-largest country in Africa by area, after Algeria.
